item.title: Utah Jazz defeat Indiana Pacers
item.description: Isaiah Collier had a career-high 22 assists and Lauri Markkanen scored 27 points as the Utah Jazz beat the Indiana Pacers 131-122 with just seven healthy players. Quenton Johnson scored 24 points on 9-of-10 shooting and Jarace Walker also had 24 for the Pacers.

item.title: Indianapolis police arrest man for throwing party at vacant building
item.description: Indianapolis police arrested Alonzo Smith for throwing an illegal after-hours party at a vacant building near the Indiana State Fairgrounds, and seized alcohol and destroyed it, while Smith faces preliminary charges of burglary, theft, criminal trespass, and maintaining a common nuisance.

item.title: Plainfield man admits to killing 77-year-old helping him ‘get back on his feet’
item.description: Zakii Dawson, 19, of Plainfield, Indiana, pleaded guilty but mentally ill to the January 2024 murder of 77-year-old Mary Sims, who had let him stay in her Indianapolis home "to help him get back on his feet."

item.title: Three arrested in Kokomo theft ring, stolen items recovered
item.description: The Kokomo Police Department arrested three individuals in connection to a theft ring after searching a property and finding stolen cars, a handgun, and other items.

item.title: Navy fighter pilot from Mooresville to be in Super Bowl flyover
item.description: Cmdr. Mike Jennings, a Mooresville native and Navy fighter squadron member, will be one of four Air Force members conducting a unified flyover during the 2026 Super Bowl national anthem performance.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers consider changes to alert system after Hailey Buzbee’s death
item.description: An online petition is demanding changes to state law following the death of Fishers teen Hailey Buzbee, including the creation of a Pink Alert and mandatory online grooming awareness training in schools.

item.title: Restaurant remembers employee Hailey Buzbee as ‘bright,’ ‘full of life’
item.description: Hailey Buzbee, a 17-year-old Fishers teen who worked at The Kitchen on Main in Fortville, was remembered fondly by the restaurant after her remains were found Sunday in Perry County, Ohio. Her father is advocating for a new alert for missing people who don't qualify for existing missing-person alerts.

item.title: Indianapolis residents voice concerns over ICE activity
item.description: Community leaders and local officials gathered in Indianapolis to discuss concerns about federal immigration activity and to encourage people to document interactions with ICE without getting involved.

item.title: 3 die in head-on crash involving semis and van in Jay County
item.description: Three people died and others were injured in a Tuesday crash involving two semis and a van in Jay County, Indiana. Investigators think an eastbound semitractor-trailer failed to stop for another slowed semi, swerved into the westbound lane, and struck the van head-on.
